title: WHAT SHAPES A CREATIVE MACHINE MIND? COMPREHENSIVELY BENCHMARKING CREATIVITY IN FOUNDATION MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on introducing C2-Eval, a benchmark for assessing creativity in foundation models based on Usefulness, Originality, and Surprise.
